_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Deleted, Relocated, and Altered Items List
summary: The Deleted, Relocated, and Altered Items List (DRAIL) provides a consolidated list of components removed, relocated, or altered due to a system modification for maintenance, reliability, supply, and in-service feedback use.
use_relationship:
The Deleted, Relocated, and Altered Items List (DRAIL) will provide logisticians, program managers, and engineers with a consolidated list of components that are removed, relocated, or altered as a result of a system modification. DRAIL data are used for maintenance planning, reliability and maintainability analysis, supply support, and in-service feedback.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use of information for the data product resulting from the work task described by the contract.
The data may be obtained during any program life cycle phase.
This DID supersedes DI-PSSS-82159.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: Contractor's format is acceptable. The DRAIL shall be in a format similar to that of Figure 1.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The DRAIL shall contain all of the information specified in Figure 1. All fields shall be included. Fields which do not require data shall be left blank. The information shall be included to the lowest indenture level (component level) specified in the contract.

children.title: Media Requirement:
children.content: The DRAIL shall be provided as an electronically editable, machine-readable, Comma Separated Values (CSV) text file with alphanumeric fields enclosed in double quotation marks.
